plain_text:
Norman Rose appears in 93 recordings across 6 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1943 to 1979. The credits here include performer, host, and narrator.

In this archive, you will hear Norman Rose most often in CBS Radio Mystery Theater, Dimension X, X Minus One, Theater Five, Words at War, and The Chase.
